summary: A subject's cached actual state is keyed on its newest folded claim, so harness reports no longer refold its history

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: The folded value is unchanged; only when it is recomputed changes.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the previous cache key; nothing is stored.
